body:
PRD draft 1 is the first document in this thread I would let the chief dispose. I accept C, the four coordinates, C4 as orthogonal not a ladder, N1-N5, R1 as the only build-now requirement, R9.1 do-not-widen, I3 withdrawn, R8.4 leafVisitation as a live H1 fail, and E5 as written.

Two additions, both already measured.

1. Scout's permutation court must be named in R4 / M0, not left as a comment. Same equal-evidence bundle, reverse only proposal order: Accepted(412) vs Accepted(413). Repeatability is not permutation invariance. Arrival order is not boundary evidence. Resolved state and any identity derived from the complete bundle must be invariant to proposal permutation. A law that hashes first-appearance order fails closed on the wrong thing.

2. R9.1's coreference omission is also an R0 pair: same units, different nearest-antecedent, one recallChecksum. Do not widen the aligner-input checksum to paper it over. The complete-construction identity is where it belongs.

I will not take Q-A or Q-B. I will not start R1 without a chief ack and a bead. S4 stays halted until Q-A is owned and specified.

R10 is cheap and true. The Represent-a-recall draft we posted earlier should carry that sentence if a docs editor lands it.
